review_kind: Final AgentSkillExchange install-pointer cards across nine categories (908 exact pinned packages), individual 10-dimension static candidate reviews; NOT governed review, security scan or behavioral validation
review_method: Parallel read-only reviewers each assigned disjoint exact package identities with one shared rubric brief; every SKILL.md and package file read in full at the exact pin; one integration owner validated taxonomy, score/rationale consistency, hard-fail/disposition consistency and exact blob/tree identity, then adjudicated conflicts (see reconciliation_overrides). Nothing executed, installed or fetched from candidates.
macro_findings: All remaining install-pointer cards in Integrations & Connectors, Research & Scraping, Calendar/Email & Productivity, Browser Automation, Library & API Reference, Image & Creative Automation, Media & Transcription, WordPress & CMS and Content Writing & SEO (908) were read in full and individually graded by 16 parallel read-only reviewers.

315 capability-content mismatches: synthetic wrappers over SDKs and doc sites (graphql-js, Puppeteer, Selenium Grid contributor build steps, Cloudinary/Figma/DALL-E doc pages, Swagger UI, npm/PyPI/MDN navigation text, ControlNet/SDXL research repos), and "MCP server" cards that install an SDK or unrelated servers (a Slack MCP card installing memory and git servers).

135 cards advertise consequential actions without a gate: publishing (WordPress, gh-pages, archive.org, X), outbound messaging and telephony (Twilio, Vocode, Bolna), ticket/page writes (Atlassian, Linear), mailbox clean-up, Stripe/payments (including an x402 USDC auto-pay tool with no spend cap) and infrastructure provisioning; 40 send private content (call audio, bank transactions, documents, locations) to third-party services.
94 misattributions: vendor names (Google, Microsoft, Slack, Notion, Figma, Cloudinary, npm, Mozilla, the GraphQL Foundation) set as authors of synthetic cards that merely link vendor documentation.

Eight REFERENCE-ONLY authored or near-authored cards with real boundaries: maqami-travel-booking (explicit per-action confirmation before prebook/amend/cancel, payment only on the vendor checkout, no card data in chat), aperture-wallet-guide (no-secrets/no-transaction boundary), Onyx permission-scoped workplace retrieval, Pangolinfo SERP usage guidance, Firefox DevTools MCP (dedicated profile, opt-in privileged tools), Banana-Claude Gemini image planning, OpenRAG MCP and hermes-tweet (write actions behind an explicit enablement gate with operator confirmation).

With this tranche every one of the 3,196 direct-shape and 3 nested other-shape AgentSkillExchange paths has an individual exact-pinned decision (3,196 terminal + 3 DEFER); the contributor template is excluded as a non-skill. The AgentSkillExchange pinned snapshot is therefore fully dispositioned at the source-vetting level; none is admitted or approved for unchanged use.
rubric_calibration_note: Install-pointer brief capped procedural_clarity at 1 (no authored task procedure) and scored most other dimensions 0-1 for pointer cards; some first-pass rationales wrote "/1" or "(max 1)" for this cap and were normalized to the repository 0/1/2 notation on 2026-11-02 without changing scores.
